verdict.rationale: Apple's docs explicitly detail the M4 Max's dedicated Media Engine with two video encode engines and two ProRes accelerators/encode-decode engines, plus hardware-accelerated ray tracing for GPU work, and real-time RAW video de-noising in DaVinci Resolve is cited as a concrete creator workflow benefit. HEVC/ProRes hardware support is well documented; AV1 hardware decode is a known Apple silicon media engine feature but not explicitly named in this evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit mention of AV1 decode/encode support, independent benchmark corroboration of encode/decode throughput.
